about.text: Năsal is a traditional Romanian cheese bearing the same name as the village where it is produced in the Țaga commune, Cluj County. It is a smear-ripened cheese made from cow's milk.

sources.text: Smear-ripened cow's milk cheese matured in a natural cave in Năsal (Cluj) by Napolact, with Brevibacterium linens; Romanian traditional product; ripening time not found
